value: Self-hosted: you maintain it, and jobs need not start on a clean instance. GitHub-hosted: GitHub handles maintenance and upgrades.
reason: Self-hosted runners 'Don't need to have a clean instance for every job execution' and 'you are responsible for updating the operating system'; on GitHub-hosted runners 'machine maintenance and upgrades are taken care of for you'.

value: Because a self-hosted runner need not start clean, files left by one job can still be there when the next job starts.
